node.title: Re^4: Shrink Images and PDFs
node.author: marto
node.doctext:
"Sorry, I meant that the Perl module comes with installing ImageMagick itself if you do it from source."

This is not true. [https://imagemagick.org/script/install-source.php|As documented] a default install does not build [metamod://Image::Magick]. You can see problems just by looking at the [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=PerlMagick+6.89-1|test matrix] and [https://rt.cpan.org/Dist/Display.html?Name=PerlMagick|open bugs]. See also [id://1227999].
